newsitem.title: USA: Walbro offers $60 mln in trust securities.
newsitem.headline: Walbro offers $60 mln in trust securities.

text.p: Walbro Corp said Wednesday its Walbro Capital Trust offered to the public 2,400,000 shares of eight percent convertible trust preferred securities worth $60 million.
This is an increase from the 2.0 million or $50 million worth of securities it originally planned to offer, a spokesman said.
Walbro Capital Trust was formed for the sole purpose of issuing the preferred securities, it added.

Under certain circumstances, the preferred securities are convertible on or after April 4, 1997, at the option of the holder, into common stock of Walbro Corp. The rate will be 1.1737 shares of common stock for each preferred security, equivalent to a conversion price of $21.30 a share of common stock.
The managing underwriters are Smith Barney Inc and Interstate/Johnson Lane Corp.

Proceeds will be invested by Walbro Capital Trust in convertible debentures of Walbro Corp. The net proceeds from the sale of the convertible debentures will be used by Walbro Corp to repay a portion of its credit facility.
Walbro designs and makes precision fuel systems and products for automotive and small engine markets.
